# Selected physical skill cells

`spark-physical.json` retains 53 unmodified physical rows, indexed by their original
table row, from RePoE native v4 manifest
`56e71e00a72c8079d100b64861fc030206b12aaeb5ad655ccb4ab4e6726332d0`
(client candidate `0.5.5.5`, producer `e41401224a085a676c84b8f14b144f20fe37c79a`).
The embedded manifest retains raw-resource and complete payload fingerprints.
Source status remains `unreviewed-acquisition-draft`; this is not game accuracy
or CN-realm certification.
Game facts and text retain GGG's rights; the fixture grants no additional rights
to upstream content.

Tests restore sparse original indices in memory and exercise the projection
directly. This is deliberately separate from the complete archive verifier,
which requires all 77 physical tables and the Default graph. Tests change stored
damage and coefficients independently to detect using coefficients as flat
damage or hardcoding the selected amounts. Malformed parallel channels and
ambiguous level rows must fail.

The one-node graph used in tree/loader unit tests is explicitly synthetic. Its
node definition and stat are these actual cells; geometry is a test coordinate,
not the official tree. The real 5,152-node replay is separate acceptance evidence.


`player-synthetic.json` is a portable synthetic player package and sparse parent
fixture. It retains the 99 real key names, but synthetic metadata/resources,
physical rows, glossary and bonus37.5 are explicitly not client or gameplay
evidence. It tests case-exact Character7 selection, Character1 override isolation,
six/twelve starting references, distinct AO/OT roots, spans and dynamic bonus
normalization without requiring the large native archives. Its binding is a test
declaration; production policy is generated by the adapter.

`../native-facts/player-context-manifest.json` is the exact metadata-only real
manifest c0412e13 at cf190d05. Its 14 producer fingerprints are checked against
fixed local Git blobs by the read-only source receipt script; no DAT or massive
client archives are copied into this fixture directory.

`primary-spells-physical.json` retains323 unmodified physical rows from the same
fixed F manifest above, selected for the actual Spark, Fireball and Frostbolt
forward chains and all120 exact authored effect/set-level pairs. It includes
referenced classification/stat/label rows and excluded stat-set identities;
source indices remain package-local. The manifest digest is embedded, without
reproducing the full archive. These are source cells, not executed projection or
gameplay results. Tests reconstruct sparse tables, retain the original order of
excluded branches, change numerical source cells independently, and exercise
malformed/aliased/missing joins and channels. Synthetic modifications inside the
tests (including a new level53 and a shared active-skill reference) are explicitly
test cases, not claims about the current source catalog or obtainability.
